# Market Flow Research

> Independent research on crypto market microstructure: second-by-second Binance order-book data for six coins since February 2026, 83 published studies and trading bots tested live. AI-assisted, human-reviewed. Research, not financial advice.

Every number in the articles comes from research logs, and losing results are published as they are. Many studies come with a research log (Markdown, Ukrainian) and a reproduction kit.

## Start here

- [How to Read This Site in Five Minutes — and Ask an AI About Every Study](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/how-to-read-this-site-in-five-minutes/): This site holds 83 studies of second-by-second order-book data and the trading bots built from them.
- [Line 7: The Best of All Our Bots — Live Trading Report, Every Trade](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/line-7-live-trading-report/): We have built and tested more than a dozen trading bots on the research published here.
- [AI digest — every study in one Markdown file](https://marketflowresear.ch/mfr-digest.md): titles, links, summaries and the key sentence of every section; made to be read by an AI in one go.

## The road to Bot 7

One question at a time: from zigzag legs to a network that reads 160 hours of order book as one canvas.

- [The Pair That Behaves the Same on Three Stretches of Data — How the Live Bot's Networks Were Chosen](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/the-pair-that-behaves-the-same-on-three-stretches-of-data/): Ranking 440 buy-and-sell pairs by money on the month they were picked on gives a list of lucky pairs.
- [One Account, Two Networks — 440 Buy-and-Sell Pairs on Validation, and Why the Best Still Trails the Market](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/one-account-two-networks-440-buy-and-sell-pairs-on-validation/): A buy network and a sell network were put on one $1000 account under one set of rules: one trade per 2.3% zigzag leg, take-profit 1.9%, stop 2.5%,….
- [Picking a Network by the Width of Its Good Zone, Not Its Best Point — 42 "Potentially Best" Networks](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/picking-a-network-by-the-width-of-its-good-zone-not-its-best-point/): Every trained network becomes a signal through two knobs: the window W over which its probabilities are summed and the threshold θ that sum must reach.
- [Teaching the Network to See Tops — Sell Pivots on BTC, One Change and Eighteen Training Runs](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/teaching-the-network-to-see-tops-sell-pivots-on-btc/): The bottom-finding network that powers our buy-only bot was rebuilt for the other side of the market with exactly one change: the label is now a….
- [When a "Fake" Buy Signal Is Really a Deeper Bottom — Rule 7.1, Tested on Validation and Unseen Days](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/when-a-fake-buy-signal-is-really-a-deeper-bottom-rule-7-1/): Our buy-only bot throws away a buy signal if price has not risen 2.3% since the previous signal — a repeat call inside the same dip is treated as fake.
- [A Buy-Only Bot on Nine Days It Never Saw — Three Take-Profits and a Draw With Buy & Hold](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/a-buy-only-bot-on-nine-days-it-never-saw/): The buy-only bot from the previous study had one weakness we wrote down plainly: its window, threshold and stop were chosen on the same 38….
- [From a Canvas of the Whole Leg to a Buy-Only Bot — What Survived, and What It Earned](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/from-a-canvas-of-the-leg-to-a-buy-only-bot-what-survived/): The last study of the series put a whole leg — and 50 rows on either side — onto one canvas and asked a network to mark pivots and corrections on it.
- [How Full Is This Leg? A Network That Finally Beats the Counter — by Reading Its Last Rows](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/how-full-is-this-leg-a-network-that-finally-beats-the-counter/): Give a network the unfinished leg — everything from the last confirmed pivot to now, as one fixed-size canvas — and ask how complete it is.
- [Where a Leg Really Ends — Four Events Earlier Than the Zigzag Says](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/where-a-leg-really-ends-four-events-earlier-than-the-zigzag-says/): We went looking for a unique, universal signature of a pivot in 531 legs of six coins.
- [Can Our Networks' Outputs Become a Buy/Sell Signal? A Simple 1.2% Zigzag Says No](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/can-the-networks-outputs-become-a-buy-sell-signal-a-simple-zigzag-says-no/): Our networks each say something about a leg: it is ending, it is 80% done, this is a reversal zone.
- [A Loss Ladder for Five Trained Networks — and the Biggest Win That Was a Dropout Bug](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/a-loss-ladder-for-five-trained-networks-and-the-win-that-was-a-dropout-bug/): We took five approved networks from this series and tried to improve them without retraining: change the loss function between epochs, raise the….
- [A Correction and a Reversal Are One Event of Different Strength — What the Book Shows Inside a Leg](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/correction-and-reversal-are-one-event-of-different-strength/): Every leg of a zigzag holds its own common level in the order book, and removing it would make the unusual events stand out — if only it could be….
- [The Book Sees the Edge of a Leg, Not Its End — Event by Event on BTC](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/the-book-sees-the-edge-of-a-leg-not-its-end/): Event by event on BTC, every feature of our order-book class carries its place in the leg: a U-shaped profile that holds inside individual legs,….
- [The Order Book Along a Leg — Slow Legs, Thin Edges, and a Signal at the End That Beats Chance ×4.6](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/the-order-book-along-a-leg-slow-legs-thin-edges-and-a-signal-at-the-end/): We laid the seven features of our best order-book class along 554 zigzag legs of six coins.
- [A Leg Moves at Its Edges — and You See the New One Only After It Starts](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/a-leg-moves-at-its-edges-and-you-see-the-new-one-only-after-it-starts/): Split every 2.3% zigzag leg of six coins into tenths and measure where the price actually travels: 39% of the move happens in the first and last….
- [The ±0.15% Pivot Zone — Seventeen Ways to Describe an Event, One Honest Ceiling of 0.70](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/the-pivot-zone-plus-minus-015-percent-seventeen-ways-to-describe-an-event/): Near every 2.3% pivot, price lingers within 0.15% of the turning level for a while — a median of 11 events, about 38 minutes, 2% of the whole series.
- [The Filter That Would Lift Precision From 51% to 93% — and Why We Cannot Build It Yet](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/the-filter-that-would-lift-precision-to-93-percent-and-why-we-cannot-build-it/): Half of the reversal-confirmation signals are false, and they share one trait: they point into the middle of a leg.
- [Can a Memory Network Rebuild Context From the Raw Sequence? Not From the Order Book](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/can-a-memory-network-rebuild-context-from-the-raw-sequence/): Trees won the reversal ladder with hand-made aggregates: five numbers about recent extremes over four look-back windows.
- [Pivot Confirmation on Three Unseen Weeks — Precision Holds, the Threshold Does Not](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/pivot-confirmation-on-three-unseen-weeks/): The reversal ladder of the previous article was scored on a held-out coin — but in the same weeks it trained on.
- [A Reversal Is a Place in the Move, Not a Shape in the Book — Five Causal Numbers Beat 62](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/a-reversal-is-a-place-in-the-move-not-a-shape-in-the-book/): The edge of a leg really is different from its middle — in 85% of 600 legs, by a factor of about 3.8, with a coin-flip control at 0.51.
- [A Reversal Has No Signature of Its Own — One in Four Ordinary Stretches Looks Stronger](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/a-reversal-has-no-signature-of-its-own-in-the-order-book/): Around a 2.3% pivot the order book changes in multiples: flow ratios two to five times bigger, book-per-flow ratios three to seventeen times smaller.
- [Derivatives of the Order Book — Reversals Leave a Trace, Not a Warning](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/derivatives-of-the-order-book-reversals-leave-a-trace-not-a-warning/): We rebuilt the basic event of this series from scratch: 210 seconds cut into ten 21-second blocks, book levels divided by the volume of their own….
- [Change the Question, Not the Network — "Will the Leg End Soon?" Scores 0.73 Where "Which Tenth?" Scored Nothing](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/change-the-question-not-the-network-leg-end-hazard/): The memory network of the previous study learned to count instead of reading the market.
- [A Memory Network Asked "Is the Leg Over?" Learned to Count, Not to Read](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/a-memory-network-that-learned-to-count-not-to-read/): An LSTM with attention walked each 2.3% zigzag leg event by event and, at every step, said how far along the leg was.
- [Four Numbers per Event and a 28-Cell Answer — Where the Signal Really Came From](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/four-numbers-per-event-and-a-28-cell-answer/): The previous networks read each book feature through 13 exponential averages and topped out at a correlation of 0.29 with the leg target.
- [Same Data, Different Readout — How a Transformer Fails Differently From an Attention Query](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/same-data-different-readout-transformer-vs-attention-query/): We repeated the previous study exactly — same 2.3% zigzag target, same pivot zone, same loss, split and seed — and changed one thing: how the….

- [Six Networks Tried, the Winner Has 53 Parameters — Teaching a Model Where Price Sits in Its Leg](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/six-networks-one-winner-with-53-parameters/): Correlations said the slow order book knows roughly where price sits inside its zigzag leg.
- [Twelve Hours of Order-Book State and the Direction of a Move — From 0.16 to 0.42](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/twelve-hours-of-order-book-state-and-the-direction-of-a-move/): Does the order book, averaged over about half a day, know which way the current move is going? - [Predicting the Next Phase of a Move From the Order Book — 832 Window Sizes, One Honest Ceiling](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/predicting-the-next-phase-of-a-move-from-the-order-book/): Every event of BTC's order book sits in one of four phases of a zigzag: rising, a pullback inside a rise, falling, or a pullback inside a fall.
- [A Leg Is the Sum of Its Events — and Size Beats Count](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/a-leg-is-the-sum-of-its-events-size-beats-count/): We cut the price of six coins into 210-second events and into 2.3% zigzag legs, then asked the simplest question a direction model has to answer:….

## Order-book research

What second-by-second order-book data can and cannot tell you: walls, drains, volume, market states, reversals.

- [A Detector for Corrections Inside a Move — and Why It Took a New Way of Measuring](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/a-detector-for-corrections-inside-a-move/): We stopped measuring how loud the order book is and started measuring how much wall stands per unit of aggression — eight features collapsed into….
- [The Order Book Tells You How Far, Never Which Way](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/the-order-book-tells-you-how-far-never-which-way/): We asked eight order-book features the same two questions at 16 horizons from one second to a day, on six coins: how far will the price move, and….
- [We Taught a Network to See a Move. It Only Heard How Loud It Was.](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/we-taught-a-network-to-see-a-move-and-it-only-heard-how-loud-it-was/): We trained three networks on the same 56,263 order-book windows and learned two things we did not want to learn.
- [A Recipe, Not a Result: How We Clean an Order-Book Dataset](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/a-recipe-not-a-result-how-we-clean-an-order-book-dataset/): This is the least glamorous and most useful study of the series: not a finding, but a procedure.
- [Throwing Away a Third of the Data and Keeping 98% of the Reversals](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/throwing-away-a-third-of-the-data-and-keeping-the-reversals/): If a third of your data provably contains almost nothing you are looking for, it should not be in the training set.
- [Twenty-Five Weeks, Twenty-Five Rebuilds: Which Clustering Survives](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/twenty-five-weeks-twenty-five-rebuilds-which-clustering-survives/): A clustering that only exists once is a story, not a result.
- [Tops Hide, Bottoms Don't: an Asymmetry We Did Not Expect](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/tops-hide-bottoms-do-not-the-asymmetry-we-did-not-expect/): This is the mirror of the previous study: the fall from a top to a bottom, 27,180 windows, the same pipeline to the letter.
- [The Rising Half of a Move: What the Order Book Looks Like Between a Bottom and a Top](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/the-rising-half-of-a-move-what-the-order-book-looks-like/): Half of every price move is a climb from a bottom to a top.
- [One Axis, Again: Clustering 56,000 Order-Book Windows Without a Teacher](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/one-axis-again-clustering-order-book-windows-without-a-teacher/): Take 56,263 windows of the order book, 210 seconds each, eight features per second.
- [One Network for Three Market States: What a Pooled Reversal Model Learns](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/one-network-for-three-market-states/): We trained one network on the events of three different market states at once — 55,929 events, 3,758 of which sit on a real turning point — and….
- [Three Classes, One Question: What It Takes to Separate a Reversal](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/three-classes-one-question-what-it-takes-to-separate-a-reversal/): Three market states, one question: can an order-book event that sits on a turning point be told apart from the ordinary events of its own class?….
- [Class 2: the Middle State Where No Single Feature Wins](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/class-2-the-middle-state-where-no-single-feature-wins/): The class 2 state fires on 21,704 windows of this dataset, and 1,961 of them (9.0%) sit on a turning point of price.
- [Reversals in a Quiet Market: Where 2.5% of Events Hide](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/reversals-in-a-quiet-market-where-two-percent-of-events-hide/): The calm state fires on 29,303 windows of this dataset, and 739 of them (2.5%) sit on a turning point of price.
- [The Storm Class: Which Order-Book Feature Marks a Reversal](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/the-storm-class-which-order-book-feature-marks-a-reversal/): The storm state fires on 5,249 windows of this dataset, and 1,085 of them (20.7%) sit on a turning point of price.
- [We Went Looking for the DNA of a Reversal. We Found a Ceiling Instead.](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/we-went-looking-for-the-dna-of-a-reversal-we-found-a-ceiling-instead/): An earlier study on this dataset (175 days of BTC) found 271 order-book events that sit exactly on the turning points of price, and showed that a….

- [Sixteen Networks, One Working Answer — and the Price Benchmark That Nearly Killed It](https://marketflowresear.ch/articles/sixteen-networks-one-working-answer/): We trained sixteen one-class autoencoders on Bitcoin order-book windows: four market states, and inside each state one network per phase of the….
